```yaml
name: Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
        
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '20.x'
        
    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: |
        dotnet restore
        cd ./GZCTF.AppHost && dotnet restore
        
    - name: Build solution
      run: |
        dotnet build --no-restore -c Release
        cd ./GZCTF.AppHost && dotnet build --no-restore -c Release
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        dotnet test --no-build -c Release --logger "trx;LogFileName=test-results.trx" --results-directory ./test-results
        
    - name: Validate Aspire configuration
      run: |
        # Verify AppHost project exists and builds
        if [ ! -d "./GZCTF.AppHost" ]; then
          echo "AppHost directory not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check for required Aspire packages
        dotnet list ./GZCTF.AppHost package | grep -i aspire || echo "Aspire packages not found in AppHost"
        
        # Validate service defaults integration
        if [ ! -d "./GZCTF.ServiceDefaults" ]; then
          echo "ServiceDefaults directory not found"
          exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "Aspire configuration validation passed"
        
    - name: Verify backward compatibility
      run: |
        # Ensure traditional build still works
        dotnet clean -c Release
        dotnet build --no-restore -c Release
        
        # Verify no breaking changes in core projects
        dotnet list ./GZCTF.Core package | grep -E "(Microsoft|System)" || echo "Core dependencies verified"
        
        echo "Backward compatibility verification passed"
        
    - name: Upload test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: test-results
        path: ./test-results/
        
    - name: Harden Runner
      uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
      with:
        egress-policy: audit
```
